name: Paul LePage
summary:
Paul Richard LePage (; born October 9, 1948) is an American businessman and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for Maine's 2nd congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the 74th governor of Maine from 2011 to 2019 and as the 50th mayor of Waterville from 2004 to 2011.
In 2010, LePage was elected governor, winning with 37% of the vote in a race with four major candidates.
